results.title: Understanding Our Refund Policy
results.snippet: Refund eligibility depends on product category. Electronics have a 30-day window with a 10% restocking fee, Apparel has a 45-day window with no fee, and Furniture has a 14-day window with a 15% fee.

results.title: How Restocking Fees Are Calculated
results.snippet: Restocking fees are deducted from the order total at the time a refund is issued and vary by product category.

results.title: Returning Electronics Items
results.snippet: Electronics can be returned within 30 days of delivery. A 10% restocking fee applies unless the item is defective or damaged on arrival.

results.title: What to Do About a Shipping Delay
results.snippet: If your order's shipping ETA has passed, wait 2 business days for carrier updates before contacting support for a replacement or refund.

results.title: How to Track Your Order
results.snippet: Log in to your account and visit Order History to view real-time tracking updates for any shipment.
